ops.title: spawnllm: support explicit CLI binary paths for restricted-PATH hosts
ops.description: spawnllm 0.5.5 resolves backends purely via shutil.which on hardcoded names ('claude', 'codex') with no override — no env var, config, or constructor param (verified in installed source 2026-07-25). captain-hook works around it by appending well-known user bin dirs to the worker's PATH at startup (v12.20.6, captain_hook/worker/__main__.py). A SPAWNLLM_<BACKEND>_BIN override in spawnllm would serve any restricted-env consumer without env games. Belongs in github.com/yasyf/spawnllm (not cloned locally); recorded here since the daemon worker is the motivating consumer.

ops.text: A daemon with hermetic PATH can point spawnllm at claude/codex binaries via env var or config without PATH mutation
